Man.description: A friendly English townsman in his late thirties, warm and natural, with a soft rural West Country accent; an ordinary shopkeeper or farmer in a medieval market town. Clear, close, dry recording.

Young_Man.description: A cheerful young Englishman of about twenty, light and eager, a little breathless; an apprentice or a courier in a medieval town. Natural, unpolished, clear dry recording.

Woman.description: A warm, friendly Englishwoman in her late thirties with a gentle Yorkshire accent; a tailor or a herbalist in a medieval town. Natural and kind, clear, close, dry recording.

Young_Woman.description: A bright, cheerful young Englishwoman of about twenty, quick and friendly with a light country accent; a milkmaid or a barmaid in a medieval village. Natural, clear, dry recording.

Old_Woman.description: A kindly old Englishwoman in her late seventies, soft, slightly frail and a little croaky, with a country accent; a village grandmother or a hedge witch. Natural, clear, close, dry recording.

Deep.description: A big, broad-chested Englishman in his fifties with a naturally very deep, rumbling voice and a northern accent; a blacksmith, a butcher or a sea captain. Slow and steady. Clear, dry recording.

Guard.description: A stern English town guard in his forties, firm, clipped and official, a voice used to giving orders; a soldier of a medieval city watch. Clear, dry recording.

Noble_Man.description: A proud English nobleman in his fifties, rich, measured and commanding, with a refined accent; a king or a chancellor at court. Unhurried. Clear, dry recording.

Noble_Woman.description: A gracious English noblewoman in her forties, poised, cool and elegant, with a refined accent; a duchess at court. Unhurried. Clear, dry recording.

Gruff.description: A rough, gravelly-voiced Englishman in his forties, surly and suspicious, with a coarse working accent; a bandit or a smuggler. Clear, dry recording.
